basic_info.description: Heart of Noe Valley - Steps to 24th Street shopping and restaurants. Light filled 3 Bedrooms 2 Bathrooms plus home with flexible floor plan. Large eat-in kitchen and Formal Dining room with Wet Bar. Front rooms have High Ceilings. Ready for new owner to renovate/repair or possible expansion and add a garage. Side and rear yards with mature tree. Extra Wide lot (29 x 100).   Note: Home has settlement and will need future foundation repair.
